title: EPIC — VOICE: speak it, get the list
desc: Phone-first: record a quick voice memo in a browser and get an editable to-do list of what was said. No account, no server cost; where a device cannot do speech recognition, the app says so honestly instead of failing silently. Spec: projects/voice-todo/JOBS.md.

history.note: all four children done and accepted: V1 recorder+transcription, V2 parser (PHRASES contract), V3 app+store (offline shell, honest fallback), V4 export (ICS + share chain). node tests for all four pass on main
